author: GamingBolt
description:
Resident Evil 7 is set in the year 2017, and unusually, serving as its protagonist isn’t an established character with years of experience fighting against nightmarish monsters, but a regular, vanilla everyman in the form of Ethan Winters. Three years ago, Ethan’s wife Mia left for what was supposedly just a regular babysitting job, but it wasn’t long afterward that she disappeared entirely off the face of the planet and was presumed dead. 

As RE7 kicks off though, Ethan receives a message from her- apparently she is still alive, and wants him to get her at a place called the Baker residence, deep in the swamps of Dulvey, Louisiana.
title: Resident Evil 7’s Story Is DARKER Than You Remember: Before You Play Resident Evil 9 Requiem

author: GamingBolt
description:
Wind the clocks back to last April and the tumultuous fallout following Marathon’s closed-alpha. Now, nine months later and less than a month from release, the game’s current state and the community’s sentiment is largely optimistic. 

At surface level, Marathon now looks a completely different game, with reworked art design, animations, and atmosphere leading the post-alpha turnaround. Yet, there is still understandable disquiet. 

The upcoming server slam, a free-to-participate stress test, slated for March 26th to February 2nd, might just dispel the gravest concerns, but whether you’re hopeful or worn out, here’s fifteen things to know before buying. If there was ever a game which needed a second look, it’s this.
title: Marathon - 15 Things You NEED TO KNOW Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
Do you remember how you got your PS5? It's probably a blur, and it wasn't released in the most stable global climate. Some struggled with it disappearing from their online carts; others waited weeks, if not months, due to shortages. Yet it was still topmost on everyone's mind. The next-gen train was here – everyone wanted to be current-gen, watching the gorgeous scenery go by (potentially in 4K). Not last-gen. Oh, what wonderful sights awaited.

Over five years later, and the atmosphere is decidedly different. We're beyond the point of complaining that this generation has barely begun or lamenting the lack of exclusives, especially from PlayStation, in recent years. Yes, last year saw two big-name titles that met and even exceeded expectations, but 2024 was downright barren, carried by third-party studios and best remembered for Sony's live-service push crashing and burning.
title: PS6 Potentially Launching in 2028 or 2029 - The Good, The Bad, and The Questionable
